core_obligations: Deduce representability of each diagonal F_i -> F_i x F_i from that of F (proof lines 1257-1259).
Produce a scheme chart U x_F F_i -> F_i that is surjective and etale (proof lines 1260-1265).
Verify the defining conditions of an algebraic space for F_i (proof lines 1266-1268).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if an algebraic space F over S is isomorphic as a sheaf to a coproduct of sheaves F_i, then each F_i is an algebraic space over S (source lines 1246-1254). The proof deduces representability of each diagonal F_i -> F_i x F_i from that of the diagonal of F, using the identity F x_{F x F} (F_i x F_i) = F_i, then transports a surjective etale chart U -> F to U x_F F_i -> F_i - surjective and etale by base change and representable by a scheme by the open-and-closed coproduct lemma - and verifies the definition of an algebraic space.
